guide.title: User Guide
guide.subtitle: From installing the extension → connecting → using each tool.
guide.overview.intro: AI AutoCut creates AI videos using Veo 3.1 running through your Google Ultra account (via a Chrome extension as a bridge). Just 3 steps:
guide.overview.step1: Install the Chrome extension — see the "Install Extension" section.
guide.overview.step2: Connect Google Ultra via the extension.
guide.overview.step3: Go to Projects or Tools to create videos.
guide.overview.note: Requires a desktop computer + Chrome browser (to install the extension). Phones can only view results, cannot install the extension.
guide.extension.step1: Click Download Extension above → extract to a folder.
guide.extension.step3: Enable "Developer mode" — the toggle in the top right corner.
guide.extension.step4: Click "Load unpacked" → select the extracted folder.
guide.extension.step5: The AI AutoCut extension appears. Pin it 📌 for easy access.
guide.extension.note: To update later: download the new version, then go to chrome://extensions and click ⟳ Reload on the extension.
guide.connect.step1: Sign in to a Google account with an Ultra plan (plan with Veo) at labs.google.
guide.connect.step2: Click the AI AutoCut extension icon → enter server, email + password for your app account → Log in & Connect.
guide.connect.step3: Open 1 Flow tab: labs.google/fx/tools/flow and keep it open.
guide.connect.step4: Extension badge ● green = connected, ready to create videos.
guide.connect.note: Google token only auto-refreshes when the Flow tab is open. When rendering many/long videos, keep 1 Flow tab open to avoid "Google session expired" mid-render.
guide.project.title: Create film from script (Projects)
guide.project.intro: Go to Projects → choose 1 of 3 methods:
guide.project.step1: From idea: type a short idea → AI writes a multi-scene script (with a review step to edit).
guide.project.step2: Manual script: paste your script → click to create & render directly (skips review step).
guide.project.step3: Copy idea: paste a video link → AI reads dialogue + description → rewrites a similar script.
guide.project.option_face: Face lock: add character photos → AI preserves the face across all scenes.
guide.project.option_audio: Audio: Voiceover (AI reads) / Character speaks (lip sync) / No audio.
guide.project.option_merge: After rendering → click Merge Film to join all scenes into 1 video.
guide.project.option_continue: Add script: append Part 2, 3… to the same project — keeps characters & faces.
guide.tools.i2v_desc: 1 image as the first frame, video animates from that image.
guide.tools.r2v_desc: 1–3 character photos → create a NEW scene but keep the exact face.
guide.tools.image_desc: Create AI images (free on Ultra). Click @character chip to lock face.
guide.tools.tts_desc: Enter text → get an audio file with voice reading.
guide.tools.cut_desc: Split video into segments by seconds, or extract frames as images.
guide.tools.chars_desc: Character photo library for face lock, reuse across all projects.
guide.tools.note: Each tool: input at the bottom, results appear at the top. F5 preserves state. Go to Tools to use.
guide.specs.aspect_ratio: Aspect ratio: Veo only supports 3 real ratios — 16:9 (landscape), 9:16 (portrait), 1:1 (square).
guide.specs.quality_free: Veo 3.1 · Lite (Lower Priority) — FREE: free (0 Gems) but slow (low priority queue, 5–15 minutes).
guide.specs.quality_paid: Lite / Fast / Quality / Omni Flash: costs Gems, renders faster / better quality.
guide.specs.gem_info: 💎 Gems = credits from your Google Ultra account. FREE model costs 0 Gems. Gem count shown at the bottom left of the sidebar.
guide.trouble.a1: Open extension → Log in again, then open 1 tab labs.google/fx/tools/flow. Green badge means it works.
guide.trouble.a2: Reopen the labs.google tab (make sure you're logged in with the right Ultra account) so the token auto-refreshes → click Reconnect in the extension → click Retry on the failed scene.
guide.trouble.a3: Only affects script writing / voice reading / image creation (does not affect video rendering). Fix: enable billing for the Gemini key, or wait for daily reset, or change key in Settings.
guide.trouble.a4: Normal — FREE model is low priority queue (5–15 minutes). For faster: choose a paid model (Fast/Quality). Keep 1 Flow tab open during rendering.
guide.trouble.q5: Creating video but Google credits are deducted?
guide.trouble.a5: FREE model on Ultra = 0 Gems (including face lock / from image). If deducted → account is not Ultra, or you selected a paid model.
guide.footer: Still stuck? Message the support team.
